notes.title: Notes & Assumptions
notes.note1_pre: This tool is currently in BETA and is based on this
notes.note1_post: . For perfect accuracy, using the original spreadsheet is recommended.
notes.note2: Grand Assault tickets are assumed to have no expiration date.
notes.note3: Pyroxenes from maintenance, some stories, PvP resets, Momotalks, and achievements are not individually tracked. To balance this, a default extra income of 1,200 Pyroxenes per month is applied.
notes.note4: All Pyroxene consumption and acquisition from events are assumed to occur on the first day of the event.
notes.note5: Pyroxenes from Total Assault / Grand Assault are assumed to be acquired on the last day of the event.
notes.note6: Events with existing data use manually extracted yields from the spreadsheet. Events without data default to a yield of 1,800 Pyroxenes.
notes.note7: Arona's login bonus assumes today is Day 1.
notes.note8: In the Strategy Tab, if you plan to pull multiple characters from the same banner, please ensure you adjust the 'Max Budget (Max Pity limits)' accordingly.
notes.note9: All 10-pull and single recruitment tickets are converted and calculated as equivalent Pyroxenes (1 pull = 120 Pyroxenes).
